Backup & restore

The JSON backup restores here in the app. The full database is a copy of everything, for disaster recovery.

What each backup holds
JSON backup covers every table — users, routines, exercises and each exercise's defaults (rest, sets, reps, weight), planned workouts (and the retired weekly schedule), history, body weight, check-ins/journal, activity types, exercise categories, exercise form notes, bodyweight, timed and just-log-it exercise flags, muscle attribution, movement patterns, goals, the injury log with its daily check-ins, pregnancy tracking (conception/due date and milestones), life phases, the daily Garmin recovery metrics (resting HR, HRV, steps, Body Battery, readiness), and your GPS routes with their marked segments — and restores instantly in-browser. The routes are the bulky part: they take the file from tens of KB to a few hundred. Garmin/Apple sync credentials are deliberately not included: see the sync cards above. Full database is a point-in-time copy of the whole database file. It is restored on the server, not from here.
